name: Parts Midwest, Inc.
old_description: Since 1972, Parts Midwest has specialized in helping dealerships strengthen profitability by integrating accessories into the vehicle sales process. Our Accessories Integration Specialists work closely with dealerships to build systems where accessories are offered with every vehicle purchase, every time—boosting margins, enhancing customer satisfaction, and maximizing after-sales revenue in a highly competitive market.
about:
Parts Midwest, Inc. was founded in 1972 in Mounds View, Minnesota. The company operates as a 100% employee-owned business and is part of the SCIPI Companies family, bringing shared ownership and international reach to its partnerships.

The firm specializes in accessories program management for automotive original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and their dealership networks. Its services include in-store training, sales call coaching, dealership performance assessments, and dealer engagement reviews, all structured around a proprietary More Accessories Profitability Process (M.A.P.P.). Parts Midwest also functions as a distribution network, managing accessory logistics outside the factory to reduce build complexity for OEMs. The company reports serving over 900 dealerships.

Its primary customers are new vehicle OEMs and their franchised dealerships across the automotive manufacturing sector. A referenced client includes Ford of Canada, where the company supported accessory business development for a decade.

The company states its mission is to simplify complex accessory programs and strengthen every link in the supply chain by aligning strategy with service, enabling OEMs to achieve consistent, measurable success. Its six stated values—do the right thing, families first, ownership, working together, respectful relationships, and fun at work—guide its approach.
